name: Tokyo Bay Ariake Washington Hotel
accessSummary: Rinkai Line, Kokusai-tenjijo Station: 3 min walk / Yurikamome Line, Tokyo Big Sight Station and Ariake Station: 3 min walk
hours: Banquet halls and conference rooms: 9:00-21:00 (late-night and early-morning hours outside 9:00-21:00 are charged 30% above the regular rate). The venue can be used from 30 minutes before the reserved time

rooms.name: 3F Iris (entire hall)
rooms.note: A large multi-purpose hall that can be divided into 3. Meeting use: 605,000 yen for 4 hours, 715,000 yen for 8 hours, 935,000 yen for 12 hours; banquet use: 231,000 yen for 2 hours (service charge and tax included; the basic fee includes 2 microphones). Exclusive one-company-per-day plan, available only on Sat, Sun and holidays: 715,000 yen for 8 hours, 935,000 yen for 12 hours, with the foyer and 1 small meeting room (40㎡) included

rooms.note: Meeting use: 352,000 yen for 4 hours, 462,000 yen for 8 hours, 682,000 yen for 12 hours; banquet use: 88,000 yen for 2 hours (service charge and tax included; the basic fee includes 2 microphones). No dedicated internet line is provided

ops.prevDaySetup: The venue can be used from 30 minutes before the reserved time, and reservations are made for a time that allows for setup and move-out. Basic setup such as desks and chairs is done by the hotel, and restoring the room to its original state is not required. Packages can be received and held on the day before the event (cash-on-delivery shipments cannot be received). Packages can also be sent from the venue.
ops.loadingHours: Usage hours are 9:00-21:00. Any hours up to 24 hours can be requested, and late-night and early-morning hours outside 9:00-21:00 are charged 30% above the regular rate. Depending on the time of day, additional fees may apply.
ops.vehicleRules: For parking, use the contracted parking lot (Ariake Park Building) on B1F to 3F of the hotel building. If it is full, it cannot be used, and parking in spaces such as the driveway in front of the entrance is not accepted. Parking is first-come, first-served and reservations are not accepted. Large buses cannot park.
ops.parking: Holds 253 vehicles; limits are height 2.10 m, width 1.90 m, length 5.50 m and weight 2.3 t. Free for up to 6 hours for meeting use and up to 2 hours for banquet use. For overnight stays, 1,000 yen (tax included) per 24 hours (1 night) from entry.
ops.waitingRooms: 3F Eucalyptus (40㎡) is a room suited for use as a waiting room or event office. With the exclusive one-company-per-day plan for Iris (entire hall), 1 small meeting room (40㎡, capacity 12 to 30 people) is included free of charge for use as a waiting room, event office or luggage storage.
ops.catering: For users of the 3F conference rooms, conference room bento boxes are available (beef steak rice bowl 2,420 yen, eel rice bowl 2,860 yen, pork steak rice bowl 1,980 yen, all service charge and tax included; served 11:30-13:30; advance reservation required). For banquets, there are buffet-style banquet plans: the Season Plan is 11,000 yen per person and the Holiday Plan (Sat, Sun and holidays) is 8,800 yen per person, with 2 hours of free drinks, for 30 to 500 people, held in 3F Iris or 21F Grand Blanc. Catering that the hotel brings to your venue starts from 100 people, from 9,900 yen per person (service charge and tax included).
ops.restaurants: On the 1F of the hotel are the restaurant "Georgetown," McDonald's and Daily Yamazaki; on the 2F are the casual izakaya "Uchoten," the seafood restaurant "Mehiko," the Chinese home-style cuisine "Rakuen," the charcoal-grilled skewers & eclectic izakaya "Maharani," the Japanese dining & soba "Takui," Cocos and WASYOKU DINING "Gazen," among others. Consecutive use pays off! With the Seminar Plan, if a reception is held after a seminar, the banquet room fee is free (the same room used for 2 or more consecutive days and a total of 12 hours or more; applies to bookings made from July 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027).
